channel.title: Animal Park
channel.desc: As Christmas approaches, will there be love, actually, for fennec fox Anthony? He has been single and ready to mingle for a while, and all his Christmases have come at once with the arrival of foxy new girl Zuri. But will she show him any interest? Meanwhile, new binturong Baloo is settling into his enclosure, eagerly anticipating a first meeting with a new mate. But the Christmas tryst doesn't go to plan as the boisterous binturong escapes!
